zh.title: 空中巴士受整合挑戰影響 A350月產目標受阻
zh.summary: 空中巴士收購廠區整合遭遇挑戰；A350客機2028年月產12架目標面臨延誤
body: 根據媒體 Simple Flying 報導，空中巴士（Airbus）原定於2028年前達成每月生產12架A350客機的目標，目前正面臨嚴重疑慮。相關報導指出，空中巴士在進行 Spirit AeroSystems 廠區資產收購後的整合過程中遭遇挑戰，進而引發了生產作業的延誤。
收購 Spirit AeroSystems 相關廠區後的營運整合難題，對空中巴士的產能提升造成影響。這些持續發生的整合挑戰，致使空中巴士能否按照既定時程於2028年將A350型客機的月產能提高至12架，出現顯著不確定性。

en.title: Airbus A350 Output Target In Doubt Over Spirit Site Integration
en.summary: Airbus faces A350 production delays amid integration challenges from Spirit AeroSystems site acquisition.
body: Airbus is facing production delays that put its target of manufacturing 12 A350 aircraft per month by 2028 in serious doubt, according to reporting by news outlet Simple Flying. The current operational delays are being driven by integration challenges resulting from the acquisition of Spirit AeroSystems sites.

Operational challenges linked to the integration of the acquired Spirit AeroSystems facilities have created difficulties for Airbus manufacturing activities. These ongoing integration issues continue to affect output schedules, raising serious doubts about whether the plan to build 12 A350 widebody aircraft monthly by 2028 can be achieved.
